quest.title: Stand by Me
quest.description: Whenever you're in trouble, won't you stand by me?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: #Haha, my dear {NICKNAME} and Paimon, my muse and my... Err, mini-muse!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: #Ah yes, and {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hah! Who's the mini-me here, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Raaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Haha, come now, don't mind me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, Paimon minds a lot!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Of course! However... Hehe, new inspiration means... that I'll need your help once more.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No problem! You pay every time, anyway.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: You see, I'm taking a photo of a Tepetlisaurus this time... Shh. Careful now, we don't want to disturb it.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: This is my first time interacting with such a Saurian, but I've been observing them for a while now... Truly fascinating creatures they are, each with unique personalities beneath their hardened shells.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Hehe, this one's learned some basic commands after being fed a few times, to boot.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Still, I'm going to need your help, dear Saurian tamers, to bring the wayward Saurian with us and take a photo of it interacting with its fellow Tepetlisaurs.

choices.text: (Not that you're the one who actually has to do it...)

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Haha, yes, that's the spirit! Come then, bring me the stray Tepetlisaurus, and we can begin!

choices.text: (And it's not as simple as you might think...!)
Require ye the succor of your... mousses once more, then?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mousse... Heh, Paimon's feeling hungry already...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Uh, you mean "muses," don't you? Those aren't for eating!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, so long as you're paying, that Mora will soon become food!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Whatever you say, Paimon... But I do indeed have money, so you shan't have to worry about working for free!

talks.objective: Indwell the Tepetlisaurus and then talk to Magnifico

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here comes the Tepetlisaurus! Let's start taking pictures, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Capital idea!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Have you noticed? Our little fellow seems to have taken note of something... Family, perhaps?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: It's heading over on its own! Come now, let's follow — we can't afford to lose it!

talks.objective: Catch up to the little Tepetlisaurus

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You defeat the enemy and smash open the cage imprisoning the little Sumpter Beast. It leaps out of the cage and sends a happy cry your way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Phew! Well, that's over. What a rush!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Shh—! Look...

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: *click*

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Perfect.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, they're getting along so well... And here Paimon thought that the Sumpter Beast might get eaten... or something.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Hehe, now, now. Tepetlisaurs might look fierce, but they're actually gentle souls.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Well, that's the photo taken, and here's your copy. Ah, yes, and your payment... here.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: *sigh* Here I thought we might capture an intimate moment between a Tepetlisaur whelp and an adult — but it seems the Sumpter Beast was one step ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, c'mon, Sumpter Beasts aren't that annoying. Paimon's sure you think so too!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Well, it doesn't matter what I think — it's the photography judging committee's opinion that counts!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Still... It might be too dangerous for our lil' Sumpter Beast to wander about in Natlan's unfamiliar environs. And I happen to need a partner to help carry some things...

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Why, I suppose I'll just have to take it in.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about its original owner, then...?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Hmph. His own fault for leaving the little beastie out here in such a dangerous spot!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: But anyway, enough of that! Fontaine's photo galleries, here I come! Haha... I trust you'll visit when the time comes as well, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: #My apologies, but I must leave this nation now. Farewell, {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Farewell, my little fellow!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Also... catch! A memento, so you don't forget me, little ones!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: "...As fragrant flowers do the dark woods grace..."

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: "...Afore we part, grant me your embrace~"

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, sorry, just humming a little ditty again.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Come then, help me find a Tepetlisaurus, and we can begin!
